title: Deer dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#1b2340'/>
  <!-- back leg (raised, dancing) -->
  <rect x='62' y='66' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#8a5a2b' transform='rotate(-20 65 74)'/>
  <rect x='66' y='76' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a3a18'/>
  <!-- front leg lifted -->
  <rect x='30' y='64' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#b0752f' transform='rotate(18 33 72)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='74' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a3a18'/>
  <!-- standing back leg -->
  <rect x='50' y='64' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='48' y='83' width='11' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a3a18'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='56' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#c98a3f'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f2d3a0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='50' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#f2d3a0' transform='rotate(20 66 50)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='30' y='36' width='11' height='18' rx='5' fill='#c98a3f' transform='rotate(10 35 45)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='32' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#c98a3f'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='24' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#b0752f' transform='rotate(-25 24 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='24' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#f3b6a0' transform='rotate(-25 24 24)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='35' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f2d3a0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='34' r='2.2' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='29' r='2.4' fill='#241505'/>
  <circle cx='32.8' cy='28.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M30 23 L27 13 L22 9 M27 13 L31 8' stroke='#e0b070' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 22 L40 12 L46 8 M40 12 L37 6' stroke='#e0b070' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front raised hoof sparkle -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='76' r='2' fill='#ffe9a0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='78' r='1.6' fill='#ffe9a0'/>
</svg>
